title: Annual Planning Group Training - May 27, 2026
description:
The Annual Planning Group Training includes a review of Council Policy 600-24, the Brown Act, the development project/CEQA review process, and a discussion on other topics related to City functions. This year's virtual training took place via Zoom Webinar. 

For more information about Community Planning Workshops, please visit
sandiego.gov/planning/community-plans/planning-group-resources.
